# MinHook 1.3.4

https://github.com/TsudaKageyu/minhook, commit `c3fcafdc10146beb5919319d0683e44e3c30d537` (tag v1.3.4), BSD 2-Clause
(`LICENSE.txt`). Only `include/` and `src/` are kept; the RDR2 backend compiles them into a static library
(`backends/rdr2-d3d12/CMakeLists.txt`). Kept in the repository so builds download nothing.
